lines.say: 11,000+ live aircraft on one photorealistic 3D globe, running right in your browser.
God's Eye View is a spy satellite simulator, except the data is real.
It pulls flight transponders, ship beacons, and orbital elements into one globe you can explore.
There are twenty layers and map sources, and seventeen of them have a keyless path.
The satellite layer alone holds an 838-object catalog, color-coded by class.
Live feeds arrive every 15–30s, and the globe smoothly interpolates between them.
You can ride inside a tracked flight in cockpit view, or switch the whole scene to night vision.
With an OpenAI key you can talk to it, and voice spending has a $5 hard cap.
It reached #1 on GitHub Trending, and the video series behind it drew 5M+ on YouTube.
To start, clone it with Node.js 24, run npm ci, and open localhost port 4173, with no account needed.
Send this to someone who loves planes, ships, or satellites.
